motion.name: ease-in-out

components.name: Primary Light Button
components.description: Primary action on a navy field.
components.css: .ds-btn-light { min-height: 50px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--warm, #F6F4EE); color: var(--navy, #0B1F33); font: 600 13px Inter, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-light:hover { border-color: var(--sea, #4E9D93); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sea, #4E9D93); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-btn-light:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Dark Submit Button
components.description: Full-width submit action on a warm form panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--navy, #0B1F33); color: var(--warm, #F6F4EE); font: 600 13px Inter, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { border-color: var(--sea, #4E9D93); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sea, #4E9D93); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 10px; color: var(--navy, #0B1F33); font: 600 13px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 0 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--silver, #B8C0C7); border-radius: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--navy, #0B1F33); font: 400 16px/1.55 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--sea, #4E9D93); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--sea, #4E9D93); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Compact navigation with a linear active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; background: var(--navy, #0B1F33); color: var(--warm, #F6F4EE); font: 500 13px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 12px 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 5px; height: 1px; background: var(--sea, #4E9D93); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .24, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav .ds-current::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sea, #4E9D93); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Linear Horizon
components.description: A labeled line that relates two operational states.
components.css: .ds-horizon { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; color: var(--warm, #F6F4EE); font: 500 11px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-horizon i { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--sea, #4E9D93); }

components.name: Static-first Media Stage
components.description: A reserved responsive poster with optional, preference-aware video enhancement and supplemental overlay metadata.
components.css: .media-stage { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: var(--media-ratio, 4 / 5); background: var(--ink, #050D16); } .media-stage-poster, .media-stage-video, .media-stage-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .media-stage-poster img, .media-stage-video { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: var(--media-position, 50% 50%); }

narrative.overview: Delaro's visual system treats the website as an architectural drawing of a business: measured, spacious, and explicit about relationships. Deep fields establish authority; warm editorial surfaces create moments for analysis; thin lines expose sequence, handoff, and causality. Static-first cinematic media may deepen the world without carrying required content, and Sea Glass appears only where attention or intervention is consequential.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-field editorial rhythm with selective warm-white analysis sections.
Asymmetric twelve-column compositions and generous negative space.
Static-first, video-ready media with manifest-backed asset IDs.
Fine linear diagrams, registers, and the recurring Linear Horizon.
Restrained, state-driven motion that preserves reading order.

rules.name: The Intervention Rule
rules.body: Sea Glass marks action, focus, or a consequential point in a system; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Ground Rule
rules.body: Compose primarily on Deep Navy or Warm White. Slate supports hierarchy but does not become a third competing page ground.

rules.name: The One-Statement Rule
rules.body: Each viewport earns one dominant typographic statement; supporting copy remains visibly subordinate.

rules.name: The Alignment Rule
rules.body: Major type, dividers, and diagram anchors share the container grid; small misalignments are treated as defects, not texture.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain in the document plane; depth appears only when it clarifies navigation state or an intervention point.

rules.name: The Motion-Explains Rule
rules.body: Animate only to acknowledge input, preserve navigation continuity, or reveal an operational relationship. Nothing loops, follows the cursor, or moves merely because it is on screen.

dos: Do let typography, alignment, and negative space create the premium character.
Do reserve Sea Glass for interventions, focus, and meaningful state changes.
Do use fine rules and diagrams to make operations, causality, and measurement visible.
Do preserve semantic reading order, keyboard access, reduced motion, reduced transparency, and increased contrast support.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glowing backgrounds, stock business imagery, or cartoon illustration.
Don't turn capabilities into identical product-package cards or invent proof points.
Don't use oversized pills, heavy shadows, centered SaaS layouts, or ornamental motion.
Don't add hero kickers by default; the homepage eyebrow is a specific approved exception, not a reusable page template.
